verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for an API-delivered identity verification product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versions, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The API endpoint, webhooks, sandbox and MCP items cover other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
